text: HSBC's principal holding company is HSBC Holdings plc, a public limited company incorporated in England, listed on the London, Hong Kong, New York and Bermuda stock exchanges. Among the major shareholdings notified to HSBC Holdings, BlackRock held 9.09% of the ordinary shares (11 July 2025) and Ping An Asset Management 7.98% (7 May 2024).
short: HSBC is owned by its listed holding company HSBC Holdings plc

source.name: HSBC: Group structure (company website)
source.quote: Our principal holding company, HSBC Holdings plc, is a public limited company incorporated in England.
source.note: Undated page; date is the day it was opened. Same page: 'Headquartered in London, HSBC is listed on the London, Hong Kong, New York and Bermuda stock exchanges.' The simplified structure chart is as at 28 January 2026.

additionalSources.quote: BlackRock, Inc. gave notice on 16 July 2025 that on 11 July 2025 it had the following interests in HSBC Holdings ordinary shares: a long position of 1,586,341,122 shares

Same list: the notice 'represent[s] 9.09% and 0.04%' of the ordinary shares in issue; 'Ping An Asset Management Co., Ltd. gave notice on 10 May 2024 that on 7 May 2024 it had a long position of 1,502,584,731 in HSBC Holdings ordinary shares, representing 7.98% of the ordinary shares in issue at 7 May 2024.'
